by_url.https://acme.com/security:
# Security at Acme

Every employee account uses multi-factor authentication.

Customer data is stored in the United States. Backups are taken every day and kept for 30 days.

Report a security issue to security@acme.com.
by_url.https://acme.com/pricing:
# Pricing

| Plan | Price | Seats |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | 49 USD a month | up to 5 |
| Team | 149 USD a month | up to 25 |

Every plan includes a 14 day trial. No card is needed to start.
